# core.resolve { #falconage.core.resolve }

```python
core.resolve(device='auto', dtype=None, *, requires_fp64=False)
```

Pick a device and dtype, and say no clearly when the request is impossible.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Default   |
|---------------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| device        | Device        | ``"auto"`` prefers CUDA, then MPS, then CPU. Naming a device that is not present is an error rather than a silent downgrade: a run that was asked for a GPU and quietly used a CPU looks like a very slow success, and the user finds out three hours later. | `'auto'`  |
| dtype         | DType \| None | ``None`` means float64, except on MPS where float64 does not exist.                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`    |
| requires_fp64 | bool          | Set from the clock's registry entry. Overrides a float32 request, with a warning, because the alternative is returning a number that is wrong in the second decimal and saying nothing.                                                                      | `False`   |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type        | Description                                                                                  |
|--------|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | DeviceError | The named device is unavailable, or float64 was required on hardware that cannot provide it. |
